237:t_100:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
($$ミライ$$... I wasn't a good husband or a good father...)

237:t_100:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(...Damn it! Am I losing heart, thinking about things like that in the middle of battle...?!)

237:t_101:0.en:
$$オットー$$
(...We're probably finished... This battle isn't a war or anything like one... It's punishment from God...)

237:t_101:2.en:
$$オットー$$
(W-What was I thinking...?! Did I, a soldier, forget to fight in the middle of battle...?!)

237:t_102:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$エミリオ$$, $$リヒティ$$, $$クリス$$... Soon, I'm sure I too... will be with you...)

237:t_102:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...What... was I just thinking...?! How could I, a tactical forecaster, give up before I even fight...?!)

237:t_102:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Is this because of this space...? Or is it that enemy's power...?)

237:t_103:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(...My will to fight is slowly fading...)

237:t_103:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(It's like when I was a child, and my desire to resist vanished before my parents' or teachers' anger.)

237:t_103:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(What is this...? Is it because... I feel a primal fear of that enemy...?)

237:t_104:0.en:
$$レド$$
(I... lived as an Alliance soldier without thinking about anything... No... Can I even call that living...?)

237:t_104:1.en:
$$レド$$
(I don't really have any right to live... I...)

237:t_104:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s vital signs are abnormal. I recommend retreat.」

237:t_104:3.en:
$$レド$$
「...No! $$エイミー$$ and the others are aboard the $$クォーター$$!」

237:t_104:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Now I'm fighting of my own free will...! I'm... alive!」

237:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$... $$ランカ$$... I... my feelings...)

237:t_105:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn it... What is this feeling that won't stop...?! Why should I have to confess my sins on a battlefield...?!)

237:t_105:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(What is this feeling...?! What... is happening to me...?!)

237:t_106:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
(I'm sorry, $$キャシー$$... I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$... I... probably won't be coming home...)

237:t_106:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
(No matter how often I shake it off, fear of my own helplessness wells up from deep inside me... This has... never happened before...)

237:t_107:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(Sis... I... may not be able to fight anymore...)

237:t_107:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(My will to fight is fading... Was I... always this powerless...?)

237:t_107:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Damn it... Damn it! $$クラン$$ is fighting, too! I can't be the only one losing my nerve!」

237:t_108:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
($$ナナセ$$... I may never see you again... I don't know why, but that's how I feel...)

237:t_108:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
(I'll do everything I can... But I... humanity will surely...)

237:t_109:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「...I'm not afraid! I'm not afraid at all! $$ミシェル$$ is fighting, too!」

237:t_109:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「I'm a $$ゼントラーディ$$! I'll shake off this fear!」

237:t_110:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
($$エディ$$... Live bravely, even without Mommy...)

237:t_110:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
(This enemy... is different from any we've faced before... Something inside me is afraid to fight them...)

237:t_111:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(I'm no longer afraid of dying... So I don't intend to resist the despair welling up from the depths of my heart...)

237:t_111:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But $$ランカ$$... I'll protect you, at least...!)

237:t_112:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Damn it...! What are these things?!」

237:t_112:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Even if you reject it, I'll sing! Don't think you can stop my soul from singing!」

237:t_113:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(Captain $$金竜$$, $$フィジカ$$... Lend me your fighting spirit...)

237:t_113:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(Something keeps trying to bind my heart...! Give me the strength to break free!)

237:t_114:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The fundamental calamity... The enemy humanity must face...)

237:t_114:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But what is this inexplicable unease...?! Is this... awe...?!)

237:t_115:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(N-No...! I can't possibly win against something like this...!)

237:t_115:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(...No... I mustn't give up...! I'm... fighting to protect $$クェス$$...!)

237:t_115:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(I can't lose...! I'll protect $$クェス$$!)

237:t_116:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(I've felt despair many times before, but this battle is worse than any of them...)

237:t_116:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What is this...?! No matter how often I shake it off, fear fills my heart...! This is... like a curse...!)

237:t_117:0.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I remember this feeling...! It's just like when the $$サイコ・ガンダム$$ tried to take control of my mind...!」

237:t_117:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「What is this...?! Fear... is taking over my heart!」

237:t_118:0.en:
$$エマ$$
(Captain $$ヘンケン$$... I wanted to see you one more time...)

237:t_118:1.en:
$$エマ$$
(But I'm sure I never will... I just can't shake that feeling...)

237:t_119:0.en:
$$ファ$$
(I'm scared... I've felt fear many times before, but this battle is different...)

237:t_119:1.en:
$$ファ$$
(Is this what despair is...? Someone... tell me...)

237:t_120:0.en:
$$カツ$$
(I-If I stop moving, I'm sure fear will keep me from ever moving again...!)

237:t_120:1.en:
$$カツ$$
(I-I have to fight...! I've fought powerful enemies so many times before...!)

237:t_121:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(They're different from any enemy I've ever fought... My body... my heart refuses to fight them...)

237:t_122:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「The fundamental calamity... You who bring despair to humanity...」

237:t_122:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But humanity will cast that aside and move forward...! I won't let you control humanity's future!」

237:t_123:0.en:
$$クェス$$
(This feeling... It's like when I first met the Colonel...)

237:t_123:1.en:
$$クェス$$
(But it's different...! The Colonel embraced me, but they're trying to control me...!)

237:t_123:2.en:
$$クェス$$
(I won't let them do whatever they want with me!)

237:t_124:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(...No...! Why do I think of things like these as my masters...?!)

237:t_124:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Is something in my heart reacting to their existence...?!)

237:t_125:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(Tch... I'm a battle-hardened veteran, and here I am trembling like a raw recruit...)

237:t_125:1.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(What are they...? They have something beyond mere strength...!)

237:t_126:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
(Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$... I've carried on your wishes and led $$エコーズ$$, but I may not be able to go on...)

237:t_126:1.en:
$$コンロイ$$
(Something crumbles inside me as I fight that enemy... If this continues... sooner or later, I...)

237:t_127:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Behind me...! $$ティファ$$ is there!」

237:t_127:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's why I can't lose! To you, or to myself, when I'm about to scream in terror!!」

237:t_127:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$!! Give me couraaaaage!!」

237:t_128:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(I... have spent all this time fighting...)

237:t_128:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Perhaps someone like me will never be allowed to live happily with the young ladies...)

237:t_128:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
(...But I'll fight... If there's no turning back, then at least I'll protect the young ladies and everyone else...!)

237:t_129:0.en:
$$シン$$
($$マユ$$, Dad, Mom... To stop war... I've ended up waging war myself...)

237:t_129:1.en:
$$シン$$
(Why do I feel this way...? It's like... I'm a child being scolded...!)

237:t_130:0.en:
$$キラ$$
(I'm sorry, $$フレイ$$... I'm sorry, $$サイ$$...)

237:t_130:1.en:
$$キラ$$
(There are others I need to apologize to... Why...? I want to fight, but my heart keeps filling with regret...)

237:t_130:3.en:
$$キラ$$
(...Even so, I...! I... will fight...!)
